fixes.summary: check_s32_dequant: stride[2] lower bound corrected from width*stride[3] to channels*stride[3] (one full pixel), stride[1] must equal width*stride[2], both strides must be element-aligned, and the exact last addressed byte is computed with overflow-checked arithmetic (__builtin_mul/add_overflow)

fixes.summary: scalar descriptors: the adapter no longer calls the shared c_utils dequantizeTensorS32 (which indexes scale_data[c]/zero_pointData[c] and would read out of bounds for scale_len==1); a new SDK-free private helper dequant_s32_nhwc implements explicit broadcast (scalar -> every channel, 0 -> no zero point) and refuses short non-scalar descriptors up front. The gate keeps accepting scale_len==1 only because of this helper. The published per-channel artifacts (scale_len 255) keep the identical per-channel path.
fixes.verification: portable_checks s_dequant_values: hand-computed 1x2x2 padded layout with scalar scale/zero (values 4/9/14/19), per-channel descriptors (10/190/30/390), F32 pass-through, and the short-descriptor refusal
